violated_contract: A capture source boundary must retain every admitted packet. Clearing a shared frame buffer after awaiting a flush erases packets appended during that I/O, including native BLE orphan packets received while a pendant reconnects.
canonical_prevention: Seal the complete old buffer with its source metadata and advance the source boundary synchronously, before awaiting disk I/O. Later arrivals remain in the new buffer. Force the write interval with a barrier and verify exact packet payloads from durable files for same-codec reconnects and codec changes.
